title: Happy bear cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="28" r="11" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="28" r="11" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="28" r="6" fill="#D8956A"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="28" r="6" fill="#D8956A"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="#A9702F"/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="17" ry="13" fill="#E8B87A"/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx="40" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="#3B2410"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="#3B2410"/>
    <circle cx="41.5" cy="41.5" r="1.6" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
    <circle cx="61.5" cy="41.5" r="1.6" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#3B2410"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M50 58 Q44 65 39 60" fill="none" stroke="#7A4A1A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M50 58 Q56 65 61 60" fill="none" stroke="#7A4A1A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx="33" cy="57" r="5" fill="#F29B8E" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="57" r="5" fill="#F29B8E" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="22" ry="12" fill="#A9702F"/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="89" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  </g>
</svg>
